definitions.gloss: no photography; photography prohibited; no filming
definitions.explanation: A prohibition on taking photographs or recording video. Commonly seen on signs in museums, theaters, temples, and other locations where photography is restricted.

examples.japanese: ここは{撮影禁止|さつえいきんし}です。
{美術館|びじゅつかん}の{中|なか}は{撮影禁止|さつえいきんし}になっている。
examples.english: Photography is not allowed inside the art museum.

examples.japanese: {撮影禁止|さつえいきんし}の{表示|ひょうじ}があったのに、カメラで{写真|しゃしん}を{撮|と}っている{人|ひと}がいた。
examples.english: There was a no-photography sign, but someone was taking photos with a camera anyway.

notes:
A compound of {撮影|さつえい} (photography, filming) and {禁止|きんし} (prohibition). Commonly seen on signs at museums, temples, concert venues, and other locations. Many Japanese cultural sites restrict photography to protect artwork, maintain atmosphere, or respect privacy.

USAGE:
- {美術館|びじゅつかん}: art museums (often prohibit flash or all photography)
- {神社|じんじゃ}/{寺|てら}: shrines and temples (some areas restricted)
- {劇場|げきじょう}: theaters and performance venues
- {試験会場|しけんかいじょう}: examination venues

RELATED PROHIBITION SIGNS:
- {録音禁止|ろくおんきんし}: no audio recording
- フラッシュ{撮影禁止|さつえいきんし}: no flash photography
- {動画撮影禁止|どうがさつえいきんし}: no video recording
- SNS{投稿禁止|とうこうきんし}: no posting on social media

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {撮影|さつえい}はご{遠慮|えんりょ}ください: please refrain from photography — more polite phrasing
- {撮影|さつえい}NG: photography not OK — casual/informal
